what_it_predicts_in_the_wwox_model: IPOTESI: fewer or smaller quanta reach the postsynaptic cell (lower release probability, lower GABA synthesis or vesicle filling, fewer interneurons or terminals) while postsynaptic receptors and chloride are normal.
favouring_observation: INFERENZA: a normal response to a directly applied agonist under TTX together with a reduced evoked IPSC (more failures, higher paired-pulse ratio) and fewer interneuron or presynaptic-marker counts per animal; mIPSC frequency down with amplitude less changed.
weakening_outcome: INFERENZA: agonist response reduced in proportion to the sIPSC loss; failure rate and paired-pulse ratio unchanged; marker counts unchanged.
compatible_but_not_discriminating: DATO: sIPSC amplitude and frequency both lower (P03) and interneuron firing intact except AP amplitude (P04). INFERENZA: the same values fit E-response and E-compensation.
control_for_a_null: A null in marker counts does not exclude lost function: pair counts with evoked IPSC from the same animals; antibody and counting rules fixed on age-matched wild type; the animal is the unit.
decided_by_source_methods: partly (P03 P04 P05: frequency and amplitude, interneuron AP amplitude; no release or number measure)
resolvable_from_public_sources: no for WWOX neocortex (P05 P14: marker deficit only in a systemic-knockout hippocampus; organoid GAD1 goes the other way)

what_it_predicts_in_the_wwox_model: IPOTESI: fewer, smaller-conductance or differently assembled postsynaptic GABA-A receptors on layer II/III pyramidal cells; release and chloride normal.
favouring_observation: INFERENZA: reduced response to a fixed agonist input under TTX; reduced mIPSC amplitude with unchanged mIPSC frequency and paired-pulse ratio; altered decay kinetics pointing to a subunit change.
weakening_outcome: INFERENZA: agonist response and mIPSC amplitude normal.
compatible_but_not_discriminating: DATO: amplitude loss at -70 mV with 140 mM KCl (P01 P03). INFERENZA: with E_Cl clamped near 0 mV the amplitude reflects receptor number and conductance and quantal size, which E-supply (filling) can also lower.
control_for_a_null: Agonist application at a fixed distance and pipette geometry, same age and animals; input resistance and cell size recorded (Table 1 shows higher input resistance in knockouts, DATO P04 context); a normal response does not exclude extrasynaptic or subunit-selective change.
decided_by_source_methods: partly (P01 P03 P05: amplitude only; no mIPSC, kinetics or agonist response)
resolvable_from_public_sources: no for WWOX (P13 transcript panel: GABRB2 and GABRB3 lower in organoids, composition confounded)

what_it_predicts_in_the_wwox_model: IPOTESI: intracellular chloride is higher or E_GABA closer to resting potential in knockout layer II/III cells at P13-P17, so GABA is shunting or depolarising and inhibition is weaker for the same conductance.
favouring_observation: INFERENZA: E_GABA by gramicidin perforated patch (or another method that leaves chloride unclamped) more depolarised than in age-matched wild-type littermates, with the same direction in the resting-potential-relative driving force; the shift removed by an NKCC1-directed or KCC2-directed manipulation.
weakening_outcome: INFERENZA: E_GABA equal to wild type and well below resting potential (resting potential of the knockout is already 5.6 mV more depolarised, DATO Table 1: PY S-WT -79.25 against S-KO -73.62 mV).
compatible_but_not_discriminating: DATO: none. The sIPSC amplitude is recorded with pipette chloride 140 mM and cannot report the gradient (P01). DATO: transcript ratio SLC12A2/SLC12A5 not raised (P13) is not E_GABA.
control_for_a_null: Positive control that the method works on the same day (perforation integrity: rupture shifts E_Cl to the pipette value, as Rinetti-Vargas used it; a transporter manipulation that moves E_Cl in wild type); a null at the soma does not exclude an axon-initial-segment or distal difference (P08: AIS matures late); a null at one age does not exclude a different time course.
decided_by_source_methods: no (P01 P02 P05: the high-chloride internal makes this explanation uninformative from the sIPSC amplitude; the only inhibition-containing record at native chloride is the burst current of P07, not an E_GABA measurement)
resolvable_from_public_sources: no for WWOX (P13 absence; wild-type time courses only in other mouse regions P08 P09 P10 P11)

what_it_predicts_in_the_wwox_model: IPOTESI: the sIPSC change is secondary to the knockout network own hyperactivity or bursting, for example a tonic inhibition change or an activity-dependent change in synaptic inhibition, and would appear in a wild-type slice driven into similar activity.
favouring_observation: INFERENZA: a gabazine-sensitive tonic current changed in knockouts under a fixed ambient-GABA and uptake condition; wild-type slices driven into bursting show a similar sIPSC change; an age before bursting begins shows normal sIPSC.
weakening_outcome: INFERENZA: sIPSC already reduced at an age or in slices without bursts; tonic current unchanged; wild-type slices in a burst state keep normal sIPSC.
compatible_but_not_discriminating: DATO: bursts are present in 36 of 42 knockout slices (86 percent) against 0 of 11 wild type (Results 2.1, P03 context), so a burst-free knockout contrast is hard to obtain inside this paper. INFERENZA: a reduced sIPSC in a bursting slice fits both cause and consequence.
control_for_a_null: Tonic current depends on ambient GABA and uptake state (P12: 170 against 12 pA with added GABA; 9 against 41 pA with uptake blocked): fix and report the condition; gabazine alone as its own control; a youngest-age series is limited by the survival window (P06).
decided_by_source_methods: no (P05 P12: tonic not measured; no age before bursting)
resolvable_from_public_sources: partly (P12 gives a wild-type tonic time course in mouse S1 layer 5 up to P7-P10 and P30-P40, not P13-P17 and not layer II/III)

what_it_predicts_in_the_wwox_model: IPOTESI: the knockout differs from wild type because the developmental time course of synaptic inhibition or of the chloride switch is shifted or compressed, so a P13-P17 comparison catches a moment on the curve (the authors own caution, P06).
favouring_observation: INFERENZA: an age series of knockout, heterozygote and wild-type littermates in which the knockout curve of sIPSC, E_GABA or KCC2 lags or leads the wild-type curve and the difference changes with age.
weakening_outcome: INFERENZA: a difference of constant sign and similar size at every age sampled, including ages where the wild-type curve is flat.
compatible_but_not_discriminating: DATO: wild-type mouse timetables of the chloride switch differ by region and method, from about P9-P14 to P15-P21 (P08 P09 P10; P11 in vivo early inhibitory), and KCC2 protein in PFC is still rising across P9-P23 (P08), so the P13-P17 window is not a settled plateau in any of the sources read (INFERENZA).
control_for_a_null: The age window is bounded by survival (P06): a lack of catch-up cannot be read at ages the knockouts do not reach; wild-type littermates at each age as reference; a null at two ages does not describe the curve.
decided_by_source_methods: no (P06: single age window, no wild-type curve in the paper)
resolvable_from_public_sources: partly (wild-type time courses exist in mouse PFC, S1 and visual cortex P08 P09 P10 P11 P12; none is layer II/III of the Wwox slice region at P13-P17 with sIPSC, E_GABA and KCC2 together)

what_it_predicts_in_the_wwox_model: IPOTESI: the halving is produced or inflated by recording conditions or analysis: no glutamate-receptor block at -70 mV in KCl, a detection threshold relative to noise, access-resistance differences, event-level statistics on few animals.
favouring_observation: INFERENZA: the difference disappears or shrinks when sIPSCs are re-recorded with glutamate-receptor block, a fixed absolute threshold and per-animal summary.
weakening_outcome: INFERENZA: the difference persists at similar size under those controls.
compatible_but_not_discriminating: DATO: the difference is large on every pooled-event display (Fig 4H-h1 viewed) and 10 of 18 reported p values lie below an event-level floor per the repository record (NEED-INHIBITORY-HYPOFUNCTION O1, cited, not re-derived). INFERENZA: this does not say whether the animals differ.
control_for_a_null: Per-animal summaries with a mixed model (cells nested in animals); access resistance and noise reported per genotype; a rerun by a person blind to genotype; a null only means the artefact is not the whole effect.
decided_by_source_methods: partly (P01 P02 P03: conditions and unit are declared; the effect of each on amplitude is not measured)
resolvable_from_public_sources: no (needs the recordings, not available as data: P13 queries)
